question: Which parts of the animal are to be offered, in what form, and to whom as a supreme offering?
premises: The omentum and marrow of the animal, and these when melted, are taken from the middle of the fire.
They are to be offered to the wheel of Shakti.
This is considered a supreme offering.
inference: Melted omentum and marrow of the animal, taken from the middle of the fire, are offered to the wheel of Shakti as a supreme offering.
uncertainties: The procedure for taking from the middle of the fire is not detailed here.
It is unclear whether other parts are excluded by this instruction.
plain_english: The omentum and marrow of the animal, and these melted, from the middle of the fire one should offer to the wheel of Shakti; this is considered a supreme offering.
